sahneler.metin: A violent EF5 tornado tore through Joplin, Missouri.
It destroyed thousands of buildings and killed more than one hundred fifty people.
Windows blew in and debris swept through the floors.
Staff carried patients down stairs by hand.
The building had to be demolished.
Its replacement was designed to withstand tornadoes.

aciklama:
Joplin tornado tore through Joplin, including its hospital. The cause: windows and exterior failing, letting wind and debris inside the building.
